pages.title: Books of Binding
pages.text: To call forth a spirit, a $(#ad03fc)Book of Binding$() must be used in the ritual.$(br)There is a type of book corresponding to each type (or tier) of spirit.$(br)To identify a spirit to summon, it's name must be written in the $(#ad03fc)Book of Binding$(), resulting in a $(#ad03fc)Bound $()

pages.title: Books of Binding
pages.text: Book of Binding$() that can be used in the ritual.$(br)
$(bold)Note:$() *The spirit names are eye candy only*, that means they are not relevant for the recipe. As long as you have the right spirit type in your book of binding it can be used.$(br)
In order to craft $(#ad03fc)Books of Binding$() to summon spirits, you need purified ink. Simply drop any black dye into $(item)Spiritfire$() to purify it.$(br)
In order to craft $(#ad03fc)Books of Binding$() to summon spirits, you also need awakened feather. Simply drop any feather into $(item)Spiritfire$() to awakened it.$(br)
Lastly you need taboo book to craft $(#ad03fc)Books of Binding$() to summon spirits. Simply drop a book into $(item)Spiritfire$() to get it.$(br)
Add the name of the spirit to summon to your book of binding by crafting it with the Dictionary of Spirits. The Dictionary will not be used up.$(br)

Alternatively, you can directly use the Binding Book: Empty instead of the previous three items. There are two ways to obtain this book. Place this book in the center of dyes to get specific book of binding.$(br)
